nota: [ESC f535] QUAD: does the all-triangle mesh lock fabric shear? quads=1 joins hood shell+lining triangles into quads in the Blender mesh (Cloth builds shear springs only on faces with >3 sides), quads=2 every fabric piece, q1s = quads=1 shear=50 (dose). Identity: quad_c0 must equal m133_sep5--sep45fa_0 bit for bit.
